title: Dynamic Alignment
note: Generated by tools/positions.py --extract from the page itself. Edit the verification, kind, signed_off_by and note fields; everything else is rewritten on the next extraction. positions.as_written: Expect walking speed and body mass to change the moment without changing the angle.
State that the predictive quantity is not the one being measured when quoting an alignment angle.
Assess thrust clinically in every alignment decision, since it is the only dynamic information routinely obtainable.
Expect a radiographic correction to change the moment by less than the geometry implies, and counsel on that basis.
Offer gait retraining and weight reduction as mechanical interventions in their own right rather than as adjuncts.
State clearly that the static angle is a surrogate for the adduction moment when explaining the rationale for surgery.

Weigh the patient's age, physiology, comorbidities, knee demand, psychological state and their own ideas, concerns and expectations, since the non operative levers here depend entirely on what the patient will do.
